title: Moduli Spaces of Connections and B-fields from T-duality with H-flux
summary: We study the geometry of mixed fields, consisting of a connection and a $B$-field on a principal circle bundle over a Riemann surface, from the perspective of gauge theory and T-duality. Motivated by the foundational work of Atiyah--Bott and Segal, we introduce a twisted Yang--Mills functional whose critical locus, in the flat case, is governed by the simultaneous vanishing of the curvature and the $H$-flux.
